landing.heroTitle: Transforming surplus food into measurable social impact.
landing.heroSubtitle: Connecting supermarkets, grocery stores, bakeries, and distributors across Colombia with foundations, community dining rooms, and certified buyers. Rescue quality food, reduce waste, and generate tangible impact.
landing.trust2: Zero platform fees for buyers & foundations
landing.trust3: Secure Colombian payments: Nequi, Daviplata, PSE
landing.statsRationsSub: In partner community dining halls and shelters
landing.statsMoneySub: COP recovered by merchants and distributors
landing.howItWorksDesc: A friction-free, transparent marketplace designed for logistics and commercial trade in Colombia.
landing.sellerStep1: Publish surplus lots with photos, quantity, and packaging expiration date.
landing.sellerStep2: Select your listing exposure duration with simple fixed rates.
landing.sellerStep3: Pay the listing fee securely via Nequi, Daviplata, or PSE.
landing.sellerStep4: Receive offers, negotiate directly, and coordinate delivery with the buyer.
landing.buyerStep1: Browse the real-time catalog with filters by city, category, and urgency.
landing.buyerStep2: 100% free access with zero subscription fees for foundations and buyers.
landing.buyerStep3: Submit formal offers proposing quantity, solidarity price, and pickup date.
landing.buyerStep4: Pick up agreed lots and certify the social food impact generated.
landing.pricingDesc: A fair fixed fee based on catalog listing time. No hidden percentages or surprises.
landing.pricingGuarantee: Includes 24/7 technical support, certified payment gateway, and automated expiration alerts.
landing.testimonialsTitle: What our active platform partners say
landing.test1Quote: «We used to discard up to 400 kg of ripe fruit weekly. With FoodLink Solidario, community foundations pick everything up in 3 days at fair prices, helping us recover operational costs.»
landing.test2Quote: «Finding grain and dairy lots at rescue prices allowed us to double meal rations for over 1,200 vulnerable families in Bogotá.»
landing.test3Quote: «The fixed-rate publication system is crystal clear. Payment via Nequi is instantaneous and the chat negotiation is exceptionally smooth.»
landing.faq1Q: What types of food can be published?
landing.faq1A: Any food fit for human consumption: ripe fruits and vegetables, products nearing expiration, inventory surplus, and quality commercial batches.
landing.faq2Q: Do foundations and buyers pay platform fees?
landing.faq2A: No. Registration, browsing, filtering, and submitting offers are 100% free for verified buyers and non-profit foundations.
landing.faq3Q: What happens when a publication expires?
landing.faq3A: Its status shifts to finished and it is removed from the public catalog. You can extend or renew it whenever needed.
landing.faq4A: We support the most trusted payment methods in Colombia: Nequi, Daviplata, PSE, Bancolombia, and debit or credit cards.
